acceptanceCriteria: generate either accepts the documented repo as a declared additional repository (roots resolved against an explicit corpus root) or refuses up front with a typed error naming both repositories, proven by a test.

body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1479. A corpus whose additional_repositories declares the documented repo A at --revision fails: additional root joined against --root, then primary revision looked up in A's object store.
